purpose: Constants required for a first-pass Fermi-contact baseline of the neutral hydrogen 21 cm hyperfine transition.

proton_g_factor.note: Listed by NIST/CODATA as proton g factor; value matches CODATA/SciPy constant table snapshots.

formula.role: leading Fermi-contact baseline for hydrogen ground-state hyperfine splitting
limitations: Uses CODATA R_infinity, alpha, electron mass, proton mass, and proton g factor.
Omits reduced-mass refinements beyond explicit mass ratio, anomalous magnetic moment convention audit, recoil, radiative/QED, weak, and finite-proton-structure corrections.
Not a UET derivation and not a validated hyperfine Hamiltonian closure.

claim_boundary: This constants package allows a baseline hyperfine estimate only. It cannot be cited as precision hyperfine validation, QED validation, proton-structure validation, or UET first-principles derivation.
